title: The watch
goals: Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# Dask is on his round.
# Cross the corridor, but wait if he is looking your way.
hints: Use an `if` condition to check if Dask is facing left.
If the condition is `True`, make your wizard wait.
After the condition, move down to the room below.
intro: Dask is walking on the corridor below us. We need to cross it, but he might look our way. We should only wait if he does.
outro: Great job. A condition is the perfect way to stay out of sight when things change.
learned: Now you know what a condition is, and how `if` does something only when the answer is yes.
